source.name: Wikisource
source.url: https://zh.wikisource.org/wiki/皇甫嶽雲溪雜題五首/鳥鳴澗

basis.en: Tang dynasty poem; the author died in 761.

note.en: One of five poems on places at the home of Wang Wei’s friend Huangfu Yue. He builds the silence so carefully that a falling flower is noticed, and then the rising moon, which makes no sound at all, is enough to wake the birds. Read it slowly; it is twenty characters about attention.
note.zh: 王维为友人皇甫岳云溪别墅所写五首中的一首。他把寂静营造得如此细致，连桂花落下都被察觉；接着，无声升起的月亮竟足以惊醒山鸟。慢慢读，这是二十个字写成的一堂专注的课。

excerpt.orig: 月出驚山鳥，時鳴春澗中。
excerpt.en: The moon comes out and startles the mountain birds, / which call now and then in the spring ravine.
excerpt.zh: 月出惊山鸟，时鸣春涧中。

gloss.en: 閑: at leisure, quiet; no one is about.
Osmanthus. Some varieties flower in spring; some readers take 桂 here to mean any fragrant blossom.
gloss.zh: 桂花：桂有春季开花的品种；一说泛指芳香的花。

gloss.en: A stream running in a ravine. The poem is one of five Wang Wei wrote on the scenery at his friend Huangfu Yue’s Cloud Valley retreat.
gloss.zh: 涧：山间流水的沟。本诗是王维《皇甫岳云溪杂题五首》之一。
